newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia's non-oil exports for 1996 are projected to reach $8 billion compared to $6.32 billion the previous year, the Saudi commerce minister said.
- The Saudi commerce minister said the trade balance recorded a surplus of 87.4 billion riyals.
- 1.169 million shares were traded on local stock markets on Sunday. REUTERS
